risks.note: MD&A Threats and Outlook both flag it: prices of raw materials are increasing due to inflation, and commodity price volatility is stated to be 'higher'. As an assembler of electrical equipment and panels the Company is a price-taker on metals and components, and it responds with procurement planning rather than pass-through.

Management names 'government slow down on the smart grid modernization due to pollical & social reasons' as a major threat. The smart-meter opportunity the Company is positioning into is created by public policy, so the demand it is investing behind can be deferred by decisions outside its control.
risks.risk: Dependence on government-led smart-grid and infrastructure spending

risks.note: 'higher level of competition seems to be major threats to the Company' (MD&A Threats) — in a segment (panels, control systems, smart meters, EV chargers) where large electrical OEMs are also expanding.

risks.note: MD&A cites global instability in the supply chain mechanism, geo-political crisis, and specifically 'geopolitical developments in Middle East' as raising cost and disruption risk.

currentContext.expansion: The only expansion event disclosed in narrative form is the relocation of the Company's second unit: during FY2025-26 the second unit was shifted to new leased premises at S.F. No. 156/2B and 156/3, Neelambur Village, Avinashi Road, Muthugoundenpudur Panchayat, Sulur Taluk, Arasur, Coimbatore District - 641407, Tamil Nadu, and commenced operations there from 11th April 2025. No new plant, capacity addition, commissioning timeline or greenfield project is announced. Energy-side investment is limited to conservation measures (fluorescent lamps converted to LED, conventional ceiling fans converted to BLDC fans on horizontal deployment) and continued use of wind energy generation for plant captive consumption since August 2016; the Directors' Report line for 'Capital investment on energy conservation equipments' is printed as a dash. Product-development effort is in-house rather than capex-led — no technology or know-how is imported, and the Company developed a new leak-testing machine for the Plastics breather component in-house. (Cross-bundle: the relocation and dividend text sits in the Chairman/MD and Directors' Report sections, the technology and energy items in the Directors' Report section of this same annual report.)
